querystring.select: SELECT CP.CUST_FULL_NAME AS CustFullName, C.CUST_ID AS CustId,  RC.COUNTRY_NAME AS CountryName, CP.MR_SALUTATION_CODE AS MrSalutationCode, CP.CUST_PREFIX_NAME AS CustPrefixName, CP.CUST_SUFFIX_NAME AS CustSuffixName, CP.MR_NATIONALITY_CODE AS MrNationalityCode, CP.MR_EDUCATION_CODE AS MrEducationCode, CP.MR_RELIGION_CODE AS MrReligionCode,C.IS_VIP AS IsVip, C.VIP_NOTES AS VipNotes, CP.NICK_NAME AS NickName, CP.MR_MARITAL_STAT_CODE AS MrMaritalStatCode, CP.NO_OF_DEPENDENTS AS NoOfDependents, CP.NO_OF_RESIDENCE AS NoOfResidence, CP.FAMILY_CARD_NO AS FamilyCardNo, CP.MOTHER_MAIDEN_NAME AS MotherMaidenName, C.IS_AFFILIATE_WITH_MF AS IsAffiliateWithMf, CP.IS_REST_IN_PEACE AS IsRestInPeace
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST_PERSONAL CP WITH(NOLOCK)  JOIN dbo.CUST AS C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CUST_ID = CP.CUST_ID JOIN dbo.REF_COUNTRY RC ON RC.REF_COUNTRY_ID = CP.WNA_COUNTRY_CODE
